workflows.actions_cache_semantics: Restore/save .lake cache keyed by OS, architecture, lean-toolchain hash, lake-manifest hash and github.sha; prefix restore omits github.sha. Save is optional and space-dependent. Then official Mathlib cache get.

workflows.target_configuration: automation/dispatch.json owner P0, fixed baseline metadata, 1..3 requests with modules array and compile_timeout_seconds.
workflows.checkout_semantics: Dispatch resolves github.sha of selected ref; full checkout; source blobs must equal HEAD. Existing committed overlays are therefore included. Rerun pins original event SHA.
workflows.runtime_semantics: 4 GiB serial guarded Lean frontend (-t0 -j2 -M4096), total job 65 minutes. Targets audited/replayed individually; dependencies freshly compiled but only explicitly named target modules receive their own declaration inventory/replay.
workflows.cache_semantics: Pinned official Mathlib/toolchain cache; fresh project/goldbach/LeanArchitect closure; optional <=6 artifact reuse IDs require existing explicit reuse-anchors allowlist and exact object/source/dependency hashes. No arbitrary project Actions cache.

    branches: [codex/yellow-closure-20261110]
    paths: [.github/workflows/t01-fifth-kernel.yml]

      purpose:

        default: yellow_green

        options: [source_validation, yellow_green]

acceptance_boundary: Inventory of previously successful exact candidate sources only. Does not prove the current combined 339-module closure or the P2.4 complete adaptive-run endpoint.
index_encoding: Each manifest scope_overlay_refs points to a unique record in scope_overlay_versions; source hashes and current-source classification are stored once. manifest_names gives the inverse mapping. Workflow/run records bind every reference to its exact historical success.
